content_html:
The artificial intelligence industry may be on the verge of another major acquisition. According to related media reports, the renowned AI company Anthropic is currently in deep discussions with the AI startup Decart about acquiring it. It is reported that the overall valuation of this deal is approximately 6 billion dollars.

As a rising tech team that has attracted significant attention in recent years, Decart has demonstrated unique technical approaches and development potential in the AI field. If this acquisition negotiation is successfully concluded, it will not only further expand Anthropic's technology portfolio and R&D capabilities, but also have a profound impact on the current competitive landscape of the cutting-edge large model market. At present, both parties have not disclosed more official information about the specific details and progress of the transaction.

content_html_zh:
人工智能行业可能即将迎来另一场重大收购。 据相关媒体报道，知名人工智能公司Anthropic目前正在与人工智能初创公司Decart就收购事宜进行深入洽谈。 据悉，本次交易的整体估值约为60亿美元。

作为近年来备受关注的后起之秀的科技团队，迪卡特在人工智能领域展示了独特的技术方法和发展潜力。 如果本次收购谈判成功完成，不仅将进一步扩大Anthropic的技术组合和研发能力，还将对当前尖端大模型市场的竞争格局产生深远影响。 目前，双方尚未透露更多关于交易具体细节和进展的官方信息。
